Nora Blake: Quick sync  noticed several complaints from QA about tiny chart lines disappearing in dark theme on older MacBook displays. Wanted to get quick reactions on fixes.
Theo Martins: Can you paste the screenshot and the token values you used?
Nora Blake: Uploaded to Figma comments. Current tokens: --bg:#05080b; --panel:#0a1116; --accent-cyan:#3dd1c4; --accent-cyan-weak: rgba(61,209,196,0.18); --accent-peach:#ffb788; code-bg:#0b1320; code-fg:#d9eef7
Rae (a11y): Main issues: small strokes + low-sat alphas on dark become indistinguishable. WCAG for UI graphics expects ~3:1 for meaningful visuals.
Theo Martins: Options: (A) increase stroke luminance for <=1.5px lines, (B) add a faint halo beneath thin paths, (C) change topology: use dashed pattern for secondary series. Which do we prefer?
Nora Blake: I'm leaning to halo + slight lightness bump. Halos help without making the chart loud. Also want to avoid relying on alpha alone because it renders differently across browsers.
Rae (a11y): Halo is good. Also ensure that the legend uses a solid swatch with a subtle border for perceived contrast. And add non-color indicators (dot shapes or dash) for colorblind folks.
Theo Martins: Implementation note: avoid expensive SVG filters. We can render a second path with stroke-width +2 px in panel color then the main path on top. Cheap and predictable.
Nora Blake: Agreed. Also small tweak for code block: current keyword blue sits too close to accent-cyan. Proposal: cool keyword -> #8fc9ff, string -> #ffcf8b (muted), punctuation -> #9fb0b9. That separates code semantics from UI accents.
Rae (a11y): For code tokens used to indicate status (e.g., "error" text), ensure 4.5:1 contrast vs code-bg. Decorative tokens can be lower.
DesignLintBot: Token change detected. Please run theme-visual-regression and a11y-sim.
Nora Blake: Action plan: Theo will prototype double-path halo rendering and attach before/after screenshots, Rae will run contrast + daltonize tests, I'll update Figma with token variants and copy tweak for theme toggle (label: "Dark  higher contrast"). Aim to merge a canary PR by 1804569800.
Theo Martins: I'll upload prototypes by EOD and include perf notes for SVG vs canvas.
Rae (a11y): I'll validate with retina scale and small-sparkline dashboard.
Nora Blake: Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
